description_en: Audits logistics parcels for compliance in the weight and dimension measurement process of e-commerce logistics by using a multimodal large language model (MLLM) and dedicated visual algorithms. The product performs structured audits on multiple dimensions such as bounding box validity, bounding box fit, and foreign object interference on scanning platforms. It adapts to different hardware capture scenarios such as white and green background boards, and outputs Boolean audit conclusions and reason descriptions in Chinese that can be directly integrated with business systems. It is suitable for large-scale and high-concurrency inbound quality inspection pipelines
description_zh: 基于多模态大模型(MLLM)与专用视觉算法协同构建的物流包裹智能审核产品,面向电商物流"件重尺"环节的合规性自动复核场景。产品针对扫描平台上包裹的框选有效性、框选贴合度、异物干扰等多个维度进行结构化审核,可同时适配白色背景板、绿色背景板等不同硬件采集场景,输出可直接对接业务系统的布尔型审核结论与中文原因描述,适用于大规模、高并发的入库质检流水线
kebab_example: aliyun aidge package-weight-size-check --raw-image-url https://example.com/raw_image.png --annotated-image-url https://example.com/annotated_image.png --region cn-hangzhou
name: PackageWeightSizeCheck

parameters.help_en: The URL of the raw image, which is the unannotated photo of the parcel on the scanning platform. The URL must be publicly accessible. The image size cannot exceed 4000 × 4000 pixels or 10 MB. Supported formats include PNG, JPEG, and JPG
parameters.help_zh: 原始图像URL，即包裹在扫描平台上的未标注拍摄图，需公网可访问。尺寸不超过4000×4000像素，大小不超过10MB，支持png、jpeg、jpg
parameters.name: raw_image_url

parameters.help_en: The URL of the annotated image, which is the original image overlaid with blue or red rectangular bounding box lines drawn manually. The URL must be publicly accessible. The image size cannot exceed 4000 × 4000 pixels or 10 MB. Supported formats include PNG, JPEG, and JPG
parameters.help_zh: 带人工框选标注的图像URL，即在原图基础上叠加了蓝色/红色矩形框选线条的图像，需公网可访问。尺寸不超过4000×4000像素，大小不超过10MB，支持png、jpeg、jpg
parameters.name: annotated_image_url
